files.title: Files
files.selectFile: Select a file to view its contents
files.invalidJson: This JSON file could not be parsed, so the source is shown instead.

gitChanges.title: Git Changes
gitChanges.selectFile: Select a file to view diff
gitChanges.selectCommit: Select a commit to view files

metadata.baseBranchDefaultHelp: This task is following the project default branch.
metadata.baseBranchOverrideHelp: This task is overriding the project default branch.
metadata.baseBranchHelp: Used for future restarts, review diffs, and PR creation for this task.
metadata.baseBranchUpdateFailed: Unable to save the base branch right now.

images.pasteHint: Tip: Paste screenshots directly with {{shortcut}} to add reference images.

notifications.backgroundTaskDescription: The task is still running. You can reopen this dialog to monitor progress.

wizard.createDescription: Describe what you want to build. The AI will analyze your request and create a detailed specification.
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior. Type @ to reference files.

worktreeNotice.title: Current Workspace
worktreeNotice.description: By default, this task edits the currently checked out git workspace. Enable an isolated workspace in Git Options only when you want a separate worktree branch.

gitOptions.title: Git Options (optional)
gitOptions.helpText: Used only when isolated workspace is enabled. Override the branch this task's worktree will be created from.
gitOptions.pushNewBranchesDescription: Publish this task branch to GitHub and set upstream tracking automatically. Disable to keep it local-only.
gitOptions.useWorktreeDescription: Creates changes in a separate git worktree and branch for review before merging. Leave off to build directly in the current project workspace.

errors.createFailed: Failed to create task. Please try again.

feedback.description: Found issues? Describe what needs to be fixed and the AI will continue working on it.
feedback.placeholder: Describe the issues or changes needed...
feedback.dragDropHint: Drag & drop images or paste screenshots

review.mergeTooltip: Merges changes from the task's worktree branch back to your base branch. AI will resolve any conflicts. You can then choose whether to keep or remove the worktree.

edit.title: Edit Task
edit.description: Update task details including title, description, classification, images, and settings. Changes will be saved to the spec files.

errors.updateFailed: Failed to update task. Please try again.

form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior.

improveDescription.tooltip: Rewrite this description more precisely so coding agents can understand it with less ambiguity.
improveDescription.rateLimit: Rate limit reached. Try again in a moment.
improveDescription.authError: Authentication required. Check your provider settings.

form.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-generate from description
form.titleHelpText: A short, descriptive title will be generated automatically if left empty.
form.requireReviewDescription: When enabled, you'll be prompted to review the spec and implementation plan before the coding phase begins. This allows you to approve, request changes, or provide feedback.

developmentMode.label: Development Mode
developmentMode.description: Choose the amount of upstream planning for this task.

direct.title: Direct
direct.description: One coding session connected straight to the selected model. Skips staged planning and QA.
direct.performance: Closest to using the model itself; best for small or obvious changes.

standard.title: Standard
standard.description: Autocode planning with requirements, design notes, task checklist, implementation plan, and QA.
standard.performance: Structured requirements-to-tasks workflow for reliable iterative development.

workflowOptimization.label: Workflow Optimization
workflowOptimization.description: Choose how this task should be executed. Direct mode skips staged planning and QA; other modes run the normal workflow with different quality checks.

off.title: Direct Mode
off.description: Send the task directly to the model in one coding session without spec, planning, or QA phases.
off.performance: Direct model path; records a final summary for manual review.

conservative.title: Conservative
conservative.description: Maximum quality assurance with comprehensive checks. Best for production releases and critical features.
conservative.performance: Baseline speed, highest quality (95-98% success rate)

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.description: Good balance between speed and quality. Best for most development tasks.

aggressive.title: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Maximum speed with minimal checks. Best for prototyping and simple tasks.

errors.invalidImageType: Invalid image type. Allowed: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP

classification.helpText: These labels help organize and prioritize tasks. They're optional but useful for filtering.

subtasks.deleteDisabledRunning: Stop the task before deleting subtasks
subtasks.deleteConfirm: Delete subtask "{{title}}"? This removes it from the implementation plan.

workPackageDiff.historyUnavailable: No local commit was recorded for this work package, so its changes cannot be isolated from other work packages.
workPackageDiff.noSourceChanges: This work package completed without committed source changes.
workPackageDiff.fileNotChanged: This file was not changed by the selected work package.
workPackageDiff.commitUnavailable: The local commit for this work package is no longer available.

logs.runtimeEmptyDescription: Runtime output will appear here when the task runs
logs.modelOutputEmptyDescription: Model text output will appear here while the task runs
logs.modelThinkingDescription: The model is preparing its next response.
logs.modelWorkingDescription: The model is active. Output will appear here when it starts responding.
logs.codexJsonParseErrorCollapsed: PowerShell JSON parse failure log collapsed.

screenshot.title: Capture Screenshot
screenshot.description: Select a screen or window to capture as a reference image

devMode.title: Screenshot capture unavailable
devMode.description: Screen capture is not available in development mode due to system permission restrictions.
devMode.hint: Use an external screenshot tool and paste directly into the task description with {{shortcut}}.

logActions.clearSuccessDescription: Task log list has been cleared.

deleteDialog.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete
deleteDialog.destructiveWarning: This action cannot be undone. All task files, including the spec, implementation plan, and any generated code will be permanently deleted from the project.
deleteDialog.uncommittedChanges: This task's worktree has {{count}} uncommitted file(s)
deleteDialog.uncommittedChangesHint: These changes have not been committed or merged. Deleting this task will permanently discard all uncommitted work in the worktree.

referenceImages.title: Reference Images (optional)
referenceImages.description: Add visual references like screenshots or designs to help the AI understand your requirements.
